description: Makes original cartoon characters in famous, instantly recognisable looks on varg: the yellow 1990s family sitcom, the 3D family feature film, hand-painted anime, paper cut-out, adult sci-fi cartoon, felt puppet and others, described in words instead of IP names (the names get blocked and do not belong in ads). Also restyles an existing character into those looks. Use when someone asks for a Simpsons-style, Pixar-style, Ghibli-style, South Park-style or Rick and Morty-style character, a cartoon version of a person or mascot, or "me as a cartoon". Part of varg-character-design (definition, sheet, reuse in video).
